regions.name: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD
regions.model_scope: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD independent 2024–25 published-rate grade-school district models use exact operational CCD LEA 4816110 / TX-101907 / TAPR district 101907 identities. All 78 native enrolled positive grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles remain searchable and enter each separate Math, ELA and Combined model using original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above rates and precise same-year individual economic-status enrollment ratios. Thirteen high schools, one primary campus and two operational alternative campuses without native records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
regions.map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Cypress-Fairbanks ISD source release.
